reason: A Feishu integration that forwards allowlisted one-to-one messages to a local DeepSeek Harness agent and posts the resulting responses, with documented local workspace and agent-tool access.

summaries.zh: 通过飞书单聊消息驱动本机 DeepSeek Harness Agent，并将处理进度与回复返回飞书。
summaries.en: A Feishu bridge that sends one-to-one messages to a local DeepSeek Harness agent and returns progress updates and responses.

capabilities: Receives Feishu one-to-one text messages over a long-lived connection
Sends processing updates and agent responses back to Feishu
Invokes a local DeepSeek Harness agent from remote messages
May access the configured local workspace through agent tools
Supports status and cancellation commands for active agent tasks
